title: No test checks that a sign-in code works only once and dies after 30 minutes
what: The screens say a code from the owner works once, for 30 minutes. The server tests check wrong tries and that a new code works, but none uses the same code twice or waits past 30 minutes. The browser tests use a pretend server, so they cannot prove it either.
expected: A server test signs in with a code, then tries the same code again and a code older than 30 minutes; both are refused.
fix_line: Add two checks to the sign-in server test: same code twice, and a 31-minute-old code

title: The code sheet the owner hands to staff is barely tested
what: Tests only check that the code sheet opens with a code. Nothing checks "Making…" and the other buttons greyed, "Works once, till …", the WhatsApp button and its message on screen, "Code copied", the row line "Code works till …", or the refusals (already removed, too many tries, no internet).
expected: A browser test makes a code and checks each of those words and the refusals.
fix_line: Add one browser test for the code sheet, its buttons, its row line and its refusals

title: Add a person: most refusals are never tested
what: Only the missing job is tested. No test types no name, a bad number, a number already on the list, or a number on another branch’s staff. No test removes a person and adds them again, or checks the half-added trainer message.
expected: Each refusal shows its words and adds nothing; a removed person can be added again with no old PIN.
fix_line: Add the four refusals and the add-again case to the jobs browser test

title: A locked PIN is never shown on screen in any test
what: Tests lock a PIN with wrong tries, but never open Staff & sign-in to check the row line "PIN locked till …" or the You card words about the lock, nor that the lock words go after a WhatsApp check or a code.
expected: After five wrong tries the owner sees the lock time on the row and the person sees it on their own card; after a proven number both go.
fix_line: After the lock in the PIN browser test, open Staff & sign-in and check the lock words, then clear it

title: The Trainer tick on a person’s row is never tapped in a test
what: The tick is only tested when a person is added as Trainer. No test ticks or unticks an existing row, checks the tick’s words, the pill change, or the error and unchanged tick when the save fails.
expected: A browser test ticks and unticks a desk person, sees the pill change, and sees an error with the tick unchanged when the server refuses.
fix_line: Add tick, untick and a refused save to the jobs browser test

title: Signing out with a payment the server refused is never tested
what: The only sign-out test with saved items has one waiting check-in. No test signs out while a payment the server refused is kept, signs back in and checks it is still there. No test signs out of a gym with branches, or checks the many-items words.
expected: A test keeps a refused payment, signs out, signs in again with a PIN, and sees the payment still named at the top.
how_often: every sign out with an unsent item
fix_line: Add a sign-out test with a refused payment and a branch gym

title: Staff & sign-in error states are never tested
what: No test opens Staff & sign-in for a gym not online yet ("Put your gym online first"), with the internet failing while online, or has Sign out everywhere fail or hit a person already removed.
expected: Each case shows its words, keeps the buttons usable, and never shows an empty list as if nobody could sign in.
fix_line: Add the not-online, no-internet and already-removed cases to the people browser test

title: Forgot PIN is tested only for the owner
what: Every Forgot PIN test uses the owner. No test runs it for a front desk person (front desk rights after, no money totals) or for a removed person (refused). The steps after the number is checked (run out, internet drop) are also never tested; the wrong words there are already listed.
expected: Forgot PIN tests for a desk person, a removed person, and a check that runs out after the number is checked.
fix_line: Run the Forgot PIN browser test also as a desk person and as a removed person

title: Put your gym online: its refusals and last card are never tested
what: No test leaves the name empty ("Type your name.") or types a bad number on this card, checks "Putting your gym online…" with the button greyed, or reads the card "Signed in as … Your gym is online…" after.
expected: A test checks both refusals send nothing, the busy button, and the final card words.
fix_line: Add the empty name, bad number and final card checks to the go-online browser test
